address.id: Kawasan Pemecutan, Denpasar Barat, Kota Denpasar. Alamat persis belum diverifikasi.
address.en: Pemecutan area, West Denpasar, Denpasar city. Exact address not yet verified.

notes.id: Jam kunjung belum dikonfirmasi ke pengelola. Puri adalah tempat tinggal dan tempat upacara: bisa tertutup sewaktu-waktu. Tanya dulu di gerbang sebelum masuk.
notes.en: Visiting hours have not been confirmed with the management. A puri is a residence and a ceremonial site, and may be closed without notice. Ask at the gate before entering.

dressCode.id: Kenakan kamen dan selendang, dan tutup bahu. Aturan busana khusus dari pengelola belum dikonfirmasi; pakai standar yang berlaku umum di puri dan pura.
dressCode.en: Wear a kamen and a sash, and cover your shoulders. The management's own dress rules have not been confirmed; follow the standard that applies at any puri or pura.

notes.id: Kebijakan foto belum dikonfirmasi ke pengelola. Anggap terbatas: minta izin sebelum memotret, dan jangan memotret di area pemujaan atau tempat tinggal.
notes.en: The photography policy has not been confirmed with the management. Treat it as restricted: ask before photographing, and do not photograph worship or living areas.

notes.id: Jumlah undakan dan permukaan belum disurvei. Asumsikan ada undakan di gerbang tanpa pegangan; periksa di lokasi sebelum merencanakan kunjungan dengan keterbatasan mobilitas.
notes.en: Step count and surface have not been surveyed. Assume there are steps at the gate with no handrail; check on site before planning a visit with limited mobility.

text.id: Puri Agung Pemecutan berdiri di sisi barat inti kota lama Denpasar. Riwayatnya belum dituliskan di sini karena sumber yang dapat dibuka dan dikutip belum tersedia.
text.en: Puri Agung Pemecutan stands on the western side of the old core of Denpasar. Its history is not written here, because no openable, citable source is available yet.
